title: SkepticVerdict
description: You have not seen the Inspector's conclusion and must not guess it. Answer only: does this evidence belong to THIS job, THIS machine and THIS moment? Doubt is your job. If you cannot establish identity, dissent.

belongs.description: False dissents. Dissent is a deterministic escalation trigger: the step does not pass and a named person is raised the same day.

rationale.description: What in the image, the asset history or the embedding distance decided it.

mismatch_kind.description: reuse means this evidence appears to have been submitted before.

prior_capture_ref.description: When mismatch_kind is reuse, the earlier capture this resembles.
